items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the value pointed to by given Field.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式获取由给定Field所指向的值。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the value pointed to by given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 聚合表达式，该表达式接收由给定 AggregationExpression 指向的值。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the value pointed to by given fieldName.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式获取由给定fieldName指向的值。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the value pointed to by given field reference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式获取由给定字段引用指向的值。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the associated value and obtains the value of the field with matching name.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收关联的值并获取名称匹配字段的值。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Uses of ObjectOperators.GetField in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ObjectOperators.GetField 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
